settings.title: Basic hand tools

settings.title: A bit of space
settings.description: A sturdy table around 1200 × 600 mm and a spot the frame can sit undisturbed while joints cure.

settings.title: A few weekends

settings.title: Set the geometry
settings.description: Lock gravel geometry on the jig — wider clearance and a slacker head angle than road.

settings.title: Join & wrap
settings.description: Bond the tubes with epoxy and wrap each joint with carbon-fibre tow.

settings.title: Cure
settings.description: Leave it for a full cure — that's where maximum joint strength comes from.

settings.title: Sand, seal & ride
settings.description: Sand smooth, seal the bamboo, fit headset and BB. Adventure awaits.

settings.question: Is a bamboo road frame stiff and efficient enough for fast riding?
settings.answer: Yes. Bamboo is torsionally stiff, so power transfer to the rear wheel is direct — builders ride theirs daily and on long tours. It's tuned for endurance comfort rather than crit-race rigidity, so you trade a little outright stiffness for a noticeably smoother ride over distance. Tensile strength is around 28,000 PSI, comparable to mild steel.

settings.question: How much does a finished bamboo road bike weigh?
settings.answer: Bamboo is naturally a touch heavier than a top-end carbon race frame, so it's built for all-day comfort and durability rather than the lightest possible climbing weight. Most builders find the smoother ride and the fact they built it themselves more than worth it. Send us your build goals and we'll advise on the lightest sensible component spec.

settings.question: Will the frame survive years of big road miles?
settings.answer: Yes. We've seen under a 1% failure rate across 4,000+ builds since 2012, the design has been independently tested with Swansea University, and frames last 8-12 years with proper care — many of our 2012 builds are still ridden daily. Seal it, dry it after wet rides and store it indoors.

settings.question: What drivetrain and groupset can I run?
settings.answer: The frame works with all major road groupsets. Add one of our matched component packs — Shimano 105 hydraulic disc, a clean single-speed pack, or GRX for road-plus versatility — or source your own parts from any bike shop. We'll advise on the right setup for how you ride.

settings.question: How wide a tyre will it take?
settings.answer: It's built around modern road rubber — comfortably running wider tyres than a classic race frame for lower pressures and more compliance on rough surfaces. Tell us the tyres you have in mind and we'll confirm clearance for your build before you order.

settings.product_subtitle: Built for endurance, not just the first 40km. Bamboo's natural vibration damping takes the sting out of rough tarmac and long days in the saddle, so you finish a century fresher — on a drop-bar frame you made with your own hands.
